name: structure-first-reconstruction-hierarchy
applicability: Use the same reconstruction hierarchy for every supported image, omitting only fields that are visibly not applicable.

required_reconstruction_spec.coordinate_system: Use normalized canvas coordinates only when they materially improve strict reconstruction; mark them as approximate rather than pixel-exact.
skeleton: outer silhouette and subject bounding region
visual center of gravity and primary orientation
proportions: landmark centers and sizes relative to the canvas and primary subject
pairwise distances and ratios between identity-defining parts
negative_spaces: openings, gaps, and intervals inside or between subjects
which object occludes which and the approximate visible fraction
tonal_masses: dominant light, midtone, and dark regions
light direction and the structural plane each value describes
depth: scale reduction, overlap, contrast loss, atmospheric perspective, and reflections where visible
color_profile: hue family, relative value, and relative saturation for each major region
local high-chroma and low-chroma anchors plus relative saturation ranking
separation between correct local color and unsupported global cast
required_reconstruction_spec.detail_gate: Texture, text, grain, and decorative motifs are compiled only after applicable structure fields are complete and must never compensate for a missing or contradictory P0 relationship.

hard_gates: Any missing or contradictory P0 identity relationship fails the reconstruction regardless of total score.
A wrong crop, silhouette, primary proportion, negative space, or major occlusion cannot be offset by detailed texture.
Prompt compilation must place structural facts before high-salience decorative detail.
A palette-defining saturation mismatch fails color fidelity even when the broad hue family remains correct.
comparison_loop: Compare generated results against the current Reconstruction Spec rather than a stored scene template.
Identify at most the two highest-impact error classes per revision.
Lock already-correct P0 fields and revise only the affected canonical or adapter constraints.
Do not claim pixel-level certainty or invent unsupported measurements.
Do not generate or retry images unless explicitly requested; stop after three automatic correction rounds unless the user asks to continue.
pass_criteria: The hierarchy is platform-neutral and runs before target adapter selection.
All requested platform-language prompts preserve the same applicable structure, tonal, depth, color, and material facts.
Fields absent from the current image are omitted rather than filled from a previous example.
Fine texture remains lower priority than global geometry.
The adapter, Markdown output, and source-image persistence contracts remain intact.
